Good experience at Spice Temple
Dec 2018 • Friends
Had lunch with my partner. The restaurant has another branch in downtown (81 Mac Thi Buoi street, District 1), but this one is new version. Located 2nd floor of Estella Place. It took me 10 minutes to get here from downtown.
We started off with Grill Pork Satay and Prawn cakes. Both were delicious. Steam sea bass with green chili sauce was really spicy, but I loved it. Olive fried rice with minced chicken was great.
Good service.
For a restaurant in mall, I wanna say the price is affordable. I highly recommend this restaurant to everyone who loves Thai food. Will comeback soon!
